intent: Trace the change in global temperature over the period from 1850 to the series end and quantify the overall shift.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
Does the video trace the change in global temperature from 1850 to the series end and quantify the overall shift?
The overall shift in global temperature change from 1850 to the series end is an increase of about 1.05 °C (from -0.1002 °C to 0.9499 °C).

units.claim: All 1 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: Global temperature change rises overall from 1850 to the series end, with the series ending at a higher value than it started.
units.computation: Compare first value (-0.1002 at point_order 1) to last value (0.9499 at point_order 79); intermediate anchors at 1900 (-0.2000), 1950 (0.2501), and 2000 (0.8501) show the upward trajectory.
accept: States that global temperature change increases from 1850 to the end of the series.
Shows the line rising from about -0.1 °C in 1850 to about 0.95 °C at the series end.
Describes an overall warming trend across the full period.
reject: Claims global temperature decreases overall from 1850 to the series end.
Describes only a single year without the overall trend.
Uses a trend claim that contradicts the first and last values.

units.claim: The overall shift in global temperature change from 1850 to the series end is an increase of about 1.05 °C (from -0.1002 °C to 0.9499 °C).
accept: Quantifies the overall shift as approximately +1.05 °C.
States the change from about -0.10 °C to about 0.95 °C.
Reports an absolute increase of roughly 1.05 °C over the period.
reject: Reports the overall shift as a decrease.
Gives a shift magnitude that does not match the first and last values.
Omits quantification of the overall shift.

optional_valid: Mentions that the minimum value in the series is about -0.30 °C at point_order 31.
Notes that the maximum value equals the last value, about 0.95 °C at point_order 79.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanations for the temperature change.
Claims about years or values not present in the table summary.
Comparing multiple panels or entities, since only one panel and one entity are present.
review_notes: The intent asks for both tracing the change and quantifying the overall shift, so two semantic units are used: one trend unit and one change unit.
The series end is represented by point_order 79 with value 0.9499; the x label for that row is empty in the summary, so the basis row uses the exact supplied fields.
The intermediate anchors at 1900, 1950, and 2000 are included in the trend unit to support the trajectory without splitting into individual data points.
